2024 National Award of Honour

In November 2024, the Association of Southern Nigerian Students (ASONIS) presented Chief Eniatimo Oludare, CEO of Atimoara Dee Global Limited, with its National Award of Honour — recognising him as an Icon of Societal Development.

"In recognition of your strategic leadership in students' development across Southern Nigeria."

Presented by ASONIS — Southwest, South South & Southeast · 23 November 2024
